Implementation complete. Summary of work on T-SIGNING-SESSIONS-API:

- Added `app/schemas/signing_session.py`, `app/repositories/signing_sessions.py`, `app/services/signing_sessions.py`, `app/routers/signing_sessions.py`, wired into `app/main.py`.
- Implemented all 5 endpoints (`GET /signing-sessions/{sessionId}`, `otp/verify`, `otp/resend`, `sign`, `decline`) against the existing `signers`/`contracts` tables (no new table, per contract).
- Treated `sessionId` as the signer row's own id since no dedicated session table exists, and skipped tenant-scoped auth for the SIGNER role since external signers have no `users` row — both documented as blockers.
- Encoded sequencing (BR-001), OTP lockout (AF-001), decline-halts-routing (AF-002/BR-008/018), auto-expiry (BR-020), and auto-Executed-on-final-signature (BR-007/019) as code, each with a test.
- Added 23 tests in `tests/test_signing_sessions.py`; full suite passes (280 passed), `compileall` clean.
- Verified every endpoint via an in-process TestClient (no Postgres available in this sandbox, consistent with every prior task on this branch) — checked status codes and response bodies field-by-field against the contract, and confirmed all 5 routes plus the auth security schemes appear in the OpenAPI doc.
- Wrote `.api-gen/outputs/T-SIGNING-SESSIONS-API.json` with status `PARTIAL` and detailed blockers for the judgement calls made (no session table, non-tenant-scoped SIGNER auth, best-effort IP capture, enum literal spelling, etc.).

cat > /tmp/verify_signing_sessions.py << 'EOF'
import uuid, hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import app.models  # noqa
from app.db import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app.models.tenant import Tenant
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.counterparty import Counterparty
from app.models.contract import Contract
from app.models.esignature import Signer

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)
db = SessionLocal()

def override_get_db():
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        pass

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

tenant = Tenant(id=uuid.uuid4(), name="Acme", high_risk_threshold=70, created_by=uuid.uuid4(), updated_by=uuid.uuid4())
owner = User(id=uuid.uuid4(), tenant_id=tenant.id, name="Owner", email="owner@x.com", role="CONTRACT_OWNER", created_by=uuid.uuid4(), updated_by=uuid.uuid4())
cp = Counterparty(id=uuid.uuid4(), tenant_id=tenant.id, name="Globex", email="c@g.com", company="Globex", created_by=uuid.uuid4(), updated_by=uuid.uuid4())
today = datetime(2026,1,1).date()
contract = Contract(id=uuid.uuid4(), tenant_id=tenant.id, contract_name="MSA", contract_type="MSA", industry="Service",
    counterparty_id=cp.id, contract_owner_id=owner.id, contract_value="1000.00", currency="USD",
    start_date=today, end_date=today.replace(year=2027), renewal_type="Manual",
    assigned_date=today, due_date=today.replace(year=2027), status="Sent", risk_score=10,
    created_by=owner.id, updated_by=owner.id)
otp = "123456"
signer = Signer(id=uuid.uuid4(), contract_id=contract.id, signer_name="Jane", signer_email="jane@x.com",
    signer_type="Internal", signing_order=1, signature_method="In-built E-signature", reminder_frequency_days=3,
    signer_status="Sent", otp_hash=hashlib.sha256(otp.encode()).hexdigest(), otp_attempts=0,
    link_expires_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc)+timedelta(days=7), created_by=owner.id, updated_by=owner.id)
db.add_all([tenant, owner, cp, contract, signer])
db.commit()

SID = str(signer.id)
sh = {"X-User-Role": "SIGNER", "X-User-Id": str(uuid.uuid4())}

print("== missing role header 401 ==")
r = client.get(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}")
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== wrong role 403 ==")
r = client.get(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}", headers={"X-User-Role":"APPROVER","X-User-Id":str(uuid.uuid4())})
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== 404 unknown session ==")
r = client.get(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{uuid.uuid4()}", headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== GET happy path ==")
r = client.get(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}", headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== verify otp bad format 400 ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/otp/verify", json={"otpCode":"12"}, headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== verify otp success ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/otp/verify", json={"otpCode":otp}, headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== sign blank pad 400 ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/sign", json={"signatureData":"  ","signatureType":"Draw"}, headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== sign happy (last signer -> Executed) ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/sign", json={"signatureData":"abc123","signatureType":"Draw"}, headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== resend conflict (already signed) ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/otp/resend", headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== decline conflict (already signed) ==")
r = client.post(f"/api/v1/signing-sessions/{SID}/decline", json={"reason":"x"}, headers=sh)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

print("== openapi paths ==")
paths = app.openapi()["paths"]
for p in paths:
    if "signing-sessions" in p:
        print(p, list(paths[p].keys()))
EOF
